description.value: Opa! of Greece is a Greek fast-food concept located inside Orchard Park Shopping Centre, Kelowna's large regional mall on Harvey Avenue. The chain is known for fresh, Mediterranean-style wraps, salads, and souvlaki made to order. A cyclist stopping here would find a quick, filling meal in an air-conditioned mall environment with seating in the common areas.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Opa! of Greece is a Greek fast-food counter inside Orchard Park Shopping Centre in Kelowna, confirmed by the mall's store directory and dedicated store page. The phone number (250-860-6721) and address (2271 Harvey Avenue, Kelowna, V1Y 6H2) are both corroborated by the mall website. The website content describes the food concept and lists the store but provides no detail on bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cyclist-relevant amenities, so nearly all amenity fields remain null; takeout is inferred from the OSM amenity=fast_food tag as supplementary evidence.
concerns: The listed website is the mall's store directory page, not the Opa! brand's own website; brand-level amenity details (e.g. menu options, allergens) are not available from this source.
As an interior mall unit, direct bike access requires locking at mall exterior racks; no bike parking details are available from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant inside an active shopping mall. Confirmed open and listed in the mall directory.
